notFound.text: The requested page does not exist.

auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

security.title: Two-factor authentication
security.required: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for the admin area. Set it up now with an authenticator app (e.g. Microsoft or Google Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden).
security.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
security.scanHint: Scan the code with your authenticator app.
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.backupHint: Keep these codes safe (e.g. in your password manager). They let you in if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
security.confirmCode: 3. Enter the code from the app
security.invalidCode: The code is invalid. Check your phone's clock and try again.

validation.dateTime: Please enter a date and time.
validation.slugFormat: 3–60 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. pm-summit-2027.
validation.slugTaken: This short name is already taken.

validation.closeBeforeOpen: Registration must close after it opens.

validation.duplicateDays: This number of days appears twice.

validation.emailInUse: This email address belongs to another person.
validation.eventFull: The event is full – choose the waitlist or allow overbooking.

validation.alreadySpeaker: This person is already a speaker at this event.
validation.sessionOutsideEvent: The session must lie within the start and end of the event.
validation.streamOverlap: This stream already has a session at that time.
validation.contactRequired: Add at least one contact person.
validation.duplicateContact: This email address is already used by another contact person.
validation.packageInUse: The package is still assigned to sponsors and cannot be deleted.

validation.termsRequired: Please accept the terms and conditions.
validation.privacyRequired: Please confirm that you have read the privacy notice.
validation.emailAlreadyRegistered: There is already a registration for this event with this email address.

validation.legalChanged: The terms or privacy notice have been updated in the meantime. Please reload the page and review them.
validation.priceChanged: The price has been recalculated based on your details. Please check it and submit again.
validation.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
validation.registrationNotPossible: Online registration is not possible with this email address. Please contact us.
validation.checkoutClosed: This payment can no longer be continued.
validation.offerClosed: The offer is no longer valid.
validation.invoiceNotPossible: No invoice can be created for this entry (not confirmed, free of charge or already paid).

validation.billingAddressMissing: Please enter a billing address first.
validation.invoiceAlreadyCredited: The invoice has already been (partially) credited.
validation.invoiceHasPayments: Payments have already been recorded for this invoice. Paid invoices are corrected via a refund.
validation.noRecipientEmail: No e-mail address available for sending (or processing is restricted).
validation.mailFailed: The e-mail could not be sent. Please try again later.
validation.priceInvoiced: An invoice already exists. The price can only be changed after cancelling the invoice.
validation.percent: Please enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
validation.refundTooHigh: The amount exceeds the amount that can still be refunded.
validation.refundNotOpen: This refund has already been handled.
validation.refundNeedsTransfer: Bank transfers are recorded after transferring the money back, not via the checkout.
validation.refundIsOnline: Online payments are refunded via the checkout.

eventForm.name: Name
eventForm.slugHint: Appears in the public address, e.g. /en/events/pm-summit-2027.
eventForm.datesHint: All times in Vienna local time.
eventForm.pricesHint: Prices are final (gross) prices in euros. 0 = free.
eventForm.capacityHint: Further registrations go to the waitlist.
eventForm.cancellationHint: Tiers: cancelling at least the given number of days before the start refunds the percentage. The row with the highest matching number of days applies.

eventActions.copyHint: Settings, prices, cancellation terms, terms of service and sponsor packages are copied – no registrations, speakers, sponsors or sessions. Please adjust the dates afterwards.
eventActions.archiveHint: Archived events are read-only and no longer appear in the event list and switcher. Archiving can be undone.
eventActions.unarchiveHint: The event can be edited again afterwards.

eventOverview.archivedNotice: This event is archived and read-only.
eventOverview.noTerms: No terms of service for this event yet.
eventOverview.seatsFree: {count, plural, =0 {No seats left} one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
eventOverview.reservedCount: {count, plural, =0 {no pending reservations} one {# reservation (payment pending)} other {# reservations (payment pending)}}
eventOverview.publicBlocked: Public registration is not possible yet:
eventOverview.noPrivacy: No privacy notice has been published.
eventOverview.noPaymentMethod: No usable payment method: invoice is disabled and online payment (Stripe) is not set up yet.
eventOverview.offeredCount: {count, plural, one {# open waitlist offer} other {# open waitlist offers}}

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.versionsHint: Each registration records which version was accepted. Old versions are kept.

legalForm.hint: Publishing creates a new version; existing consents stay linked to the old version.

settings.title: Settings
settings.organizerHint: These details appear on invoices and credit notes.
settings.name: Organizer name
settings.vatIdRequiredHint: Mandatory on invoices with standard VAT.
settings.vatModeHint: Changes only affect invoices issued afterwards.
settings.privacyHint: Linked on the registration page, in the attendee portal and in emails (specification 7.1).

attendees.title: Attendees
attendees.badgeHint: Tip: click a role or status to filter by it; hold Ctrl (Mac: Cmd) to select several.
attendees.cancelHint: The registration is kept with status “Cancelled” and the seat becomes free. Refund and credit note are calculated from the cancellation terms.
attendees.confirmHint: {count, plural, one {# seat is free.} other {# seats are free.}}
attendees.confirmFull: The event is full. Confirming is only possible with overbooking.
attendees.issueInvoiceHint: The invoice gets the next consecutive number, cannot be changed afterwards and is sent to the person as a PDF by e-mail. Corrections are only possible via a credit note.
attendees.confirmMailHint: The person receives a confirmation by e-mail (for invoice payment with the invoice attached).
attendees.cancelNoRules: No cancellation terms are set for this event – a refund is only made if you enter a rate.
attendees.cancelRule: {days, plural, =0 {Cancellation on the event day} one {Cancellation # day before the start} other {Cancellation # days before the start}} – {percent} % refund according to the cancellation terms.
attendees.cancelPercentHint: Pre-filled from the cancellation terms; deviations are logged.
attendees.cancelRefundOnline: The refund is executed immediately via the online checkout.
attendees.cancelRefundTransfer: Paid by bank transfer: the refund appears under “Refunds” and is recorded after you have transferred the money back.
attendees.refundFailedHint: The refund failed – please retry under “Refunds”.
attendees.refundHint: Up to {amount} can be refunded. The registration remains active. A credit note is created and sent by e-mail.
attendees.refundReasonHint: Required; shown on the credit note.
attendees.refundApprovedTransfer: Refund approved – record it under “Refunds” after transferring the money.

registrationForm.createHint: If the email address already exists, the existing person is used and their details are updated.
registrationForm.localeHint: Confirmations and invoices are sent in this language.
registrationForm.priceLocked: Already paid – can no longer be changed.
registrationForm.overbook: Event is full – deliberately exceed capacity
registrationForm.notifyConfirmed: Send confirmation by e-mail (with the invoice attached if the price is above 0)

members.title: Member list
members.current: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}} stored
members.fileHint: Required columns: member number and last name; optional first name, email, valid until. The first row contains the headers (German or English). The upload replaces the entire list.
members.hasErrors: {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} found – please fix the file and upload it again. Nothing was imported.
members.removeWarning: {count, plural, one {# existing member is} other {# existing members are}} no longer in the new file and will be removed.
members.apply: Import {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} (replace list)
members.listHint: At registration, the member price only applies if member number and last name match an entry and the membership is valid.

errors.fileType: Only CSV or Excel files (.xlsx) are supported.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
errors.tooManyRows: The file has more than 20,000 rows.
errors.missingColumns: Columns “member number” and “last name” not found – please check the headers.
errors.duplicate: Member number {value} appears more than once.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.removeHint: The person stays stored; assigned sessions remain, but without a speaker.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.deleteHint: The session will be deleted permanently.
schedule.printHint: Header and navigation are not printed.
schedule.speaker: Speaker
schedule.streamHint: Parallel sessions go in different streams.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.bookedCount: {count, plural, =0 {not booked} one {# sponsor} other {# sponsors}}
sponsors.totals: {count, plural, one {# sponsor} other {# sponsors}} · total {total} · paid {paid} · open {open}
sponsors.deletePackageHint: The package will be removed permanently.
sponsors.deleteSponsorHint: The sponsor and its contact assignments will be removed. The people themselves are kept.
sponsors.paymentHint: Set automatically when the invoice is sent, when payments are recorded and when it becomes overdue.
sponsors.issueInvoiceHint: The invoice gets the next consecutive number and is sent as a PDF to the first contact person. Due date: the date entered, otherwise the payment term from the settings. Corrections only via credit note.
sponsors.vatIdHint: Required on invoices above €10,000 gross when charging VAT.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.organizerIncomplete: The organizer details are incomplete – invoices can only be issued once name and address (and the VAT ID when charging VAT) are set.
invoices.mailToFileHint: Development mode: e-mails are not sent but saved as .eml files in data/mail-outbox.
invoices.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices yet} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} · {openCount} open totalling {open} · of which overdue {overdue}
invoices.reminders: {count, plural, one {# reminder} other {# reminders}} sent
invoices.empty: No invoices for this event yet.
invoices.paymentHint: Record a bank transfer. Open: {open}. Once the amount is paid in full, the payment is marked as “Paid”.
invoices.cancelHint: A credit note for the full amount is created and sent by e-mail. The invoice itself remains unchanged. Afterwards a new invoice can be created.
invoices.cancelReasonHint: Shown on the credit note, e.g. “Wrong billing address”.
invoices.creditIssuedNotSent: Credit note {number} created but not sent

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.modeAutomatic: Refund mode of this event: automatic – cancellations by attendees are refunded immediately (online payment) or approved for transfer.
refunds.modeApproval: Refund mode of this event: with approval – cancellations by attendees create a proposal that an admin approves, changes or rejects.
refunds.summary: {open, plural, =0 {No open refunds} one {# open refund} other {# open refunds}} · {total} in total
refunds.failedAgain: Refund failed – see details in the list
refunds.approvedTransfer: Approved – record it after transferring the money
refunds.approveHint: Proposed: {amount} (payment {paid}). You can change the amount.
refunds.approveOnline: The refund is executed immediately via the online checkout.
refunds.approveTransfer: Then transfer the money and record the transfer here.
refunds.rejectHint: Nothing is refunded and no credit note is created. Please inform the person yourself if needed.
refunds.transferHint: Only record once the transfer has been made. The credit note and e-mail are then sent.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: All changes and exports are logged with time and admin. Descriptions contain no personal data and are stored in German.

publicForm.emailHint: We will send the confirmation to this address.
publicForm.memberNumberHint: For the member price: number and last name must match the member list.
publicForm.memberValid: Membership confirmed – the member price applies.
publicForm.memberInvalid: Member number not found or last name does not match – the regular price applies.
